title: Yixing Huang
text: Yixing Huang Contact Information Email: huangyx at pku.edu.cn Research Interests Medical Imaging Processing Medical Artificial Intelligence Computed Tomography Radiation Oncology Welcome to AIMI LAB! Yixing Huang Huang Yixing is currently an Assistant Professor and Full Research Professor at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center. He received his Bachelor’s degree from Peking University in 2013, and his Master’s and Doctoral degrees from Friedrich-Alexander-University Erlangen-Nuremberg in Germany in 2016 and 2020, respectively. His research primarily focuses on cone-beam CT reconstruction and image analysis, as well as medical image analysis in tumor radiotherapy, including limited-angle reconstruction, field-of-view extension, MRI brain metastasis detection and segmentation, large language model-assisted decision-making, and survival prediction for cancer patients. To date, he has published over 50 academic papers and holds 3 patents, with 30 journal and conference papers as first author or corresponding author, including top medical imaging journals TMI and MedIA, top conference MICCAI, and the Red Journal and Green Journal of radiation oncology. He leads the National Natural Science Foundation of China Excellent Young Scientists Fund (Overseas), the National Natural Science Foundation of China General Program, the Capital Health Development Research Special Youth Key Research Project, and the Beijing Natural Science Foundation Joint Fund Cultivation Project. He is a doctoral supervisor and a recipient of the 2024 Excellent Young Scientists Fund (Overseas). title: Meng Li
text: Dr. Meng Li Contact Information Email: mengli@pku.edu.cn Research Interests Multimodal MRI Brain Networks Medical Artificial Intelligence Meng Li is currently a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center, working under the supervision of Dr. Yixing Huang. She obtained her Ph.D. through the joint doctoral program between Northeastern University and the University of Pennsylvania. Her research primarily focuses on developing multimodal MRI-based methodologies to assess brain pathologies and identify potential biomarkers associated with neuropsychiatric disorders. She has conducted some innovative research in the field of brain science and published a number of peer-reviewed works. https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Meng-Li-297 Monday–Friday, 7 a.m.–4 p.m. Room 405, Building 12, Peking University Industrial Park, Changping District, Beijing

title: Haijun Yu
text: Haijun Yu Contact Information Email: yuhj@pku.edu.cn Research Interests Computed Tomography Medical Artificial Intelligence Welcome to AIMI LAB! Haijun Yu Haijun Yu is a Boya Postdoctoral Fellow at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center, with his collaborating supervisor being Asst. Prof. Yixing Huang. He obtained his doctoral degree from Chongqing University in September 2024. He conducted research as a joint-training doctoral student at Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg, Germany in 2023 under the sponsorship of the China Scholarship Council (CSC). His main research areas include linear CT technology and systems, intelligent CT image reconstruction and analysis. He has published 35 academic papers with 13 as first/corresponding author in SCI journals such as Applied Mathematical Modelling, IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement, IEEE Transactions on Radiation and Plasma Medical Sciences, Signal Processing, Optics Express. The lab is dedicated to advancing both fundamental research and clinical translation of artificial intelligence in medical imaging, with a strong focus on precision medicine. Its research areas include CT image reconstruction, MRI-based tumor segmentation, image-guided radiation oncology, patient prognosis and survival analysis, digital pathology, and computer-vision-driven medical image generation. AIMI strives to develop cutting-edge intelligent imaging technologies to support disease diagnosis, treatment planning, and therapy assessment. Artificial Intelligence for Medical Imaging

title: Our Paper Receives Acceptance from Physics in Medicine & Biology!
text: The manuscript “Self-Cascade Latent Schrödinger Bridge for CT Field-of-View Extension,” authored by Xihao Wu, Jiacheng Liu, Haijun Yu, Andreas Maier, and Yixing Huang, has been accepted by Physics in Medicine & Biology. The study introduces a self-cascade latent Schrödinger bridge (SCL-SB) that combines a two-round shared-weight cascade with a frequency-aware residual mechanism to recover missing peripheral anatomy in truncated CT images while maintaining efficient inference. Congratulations to all the authors!

title: Welcome PhD Student Ao Wang to Our Team!
text: We are delighted to announce that Ao Wang has officially joined our group as a PhD student on September 1st, 2026. Ao received his master’s degree in Instrument Science and Technology from Chongqing University, and his research will focus on CT reconstruction algorithms. We believe his expertise will further strengthen our efforts in advancing cutting-edge medical imaging technologies. We look forward to his contributions and wish him great success in his doctoral studies!

title: Welcome PhD Student Zuodong Zhong to Our Team!
text: We are delighted to announce that Zuodong Zhong officially joined our group as a PhD student in September 2026. He received his bachelor’s degree from the School of Automation at the University of Science and Technology Beijing. His research interests include long-form medical video understanding and efficient architectures for multimodal large models. We look forward to his contributions and wish him great success in his doctoral studies!

title: Welcome Master Student Jiachen Tang to Our Team!
text: We are pleased to welcome Tang Jiachen, who has officially joined our group as a master’s student on September 1st, 2026. She completed her bachelor’s degree at School of Computer Science, Beijing Institute of Technology. During her undergraduate studies, she co-authored a paper on explainable medical image analysis as a co-first author, which was accepted to MICCAI 2025, a top-tier conference in medical imaging, and published. The paper also received a conference award. Her current research will focus on the application of quantum computing combined with artificial intelligence in medical imaging, an emerging and interdisciplinary frontier with great potential. We look forward to her innovative contributions and wish her a fruitful and rewarding graduate journey!

title: The College of Engineering at Peking University held its 2026 Opening Ceremony and Military Training Kick-off Ceremony
text: Dr. Huang Yixing was invited to attend the ceremony and delivered a speech as an alumnus representative of the College of Engineering. In his remarks , he reflected on his time as a member of the inaugural undergraduate cohort in Biomedical Engineering, recalling formative experiences such as small-class intensive teaching, an interdisciplinary curriculum, mentorship in undergraduate research, and summer overseas exchange programs. He expressed his gratitude to the School for its meticulous cultivation of students. Drawing on his personal journey, he also shared practical advice with the incoming students on planning their academic paths.

title: Graph-Guided 3D Gaussian Framework Published in IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging
text: Our graph-guided 3D Gaussian framework, featuring denoised initialization and pixel-graph-aware densification to suppress sparse-view artifacts in cone-beam CT reconstruction, has been successfully published in IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging.

title: Advanced Medical Artificial Intelligence Receives Graduate Course Development Funding
text: The graduate course “Advanced Medical Artificial Intelligence,” led by Professor Huang Yixing, has successfully received funding from Peking University’s 2025 Graduate Course Development Initiative! The funding amount for each course is 20,000 RMB. In the fall of 2025, the “Advanced Medical Artificial Intelligence” course attracted 178 students from various departments and affiliated hospitals of Peking University Health Science Center in its first offering, far exceeding expectations. The course quality has been highly praised by both faculty and students. Special thanks to every lecturers for their tremendous support!

title: Zuodong Zhong Receives the 2025 Baosteel Outstanding Student Award
text: Congratulations to Zuodong Zhong on receiving the 2025 Baosteel Outstanding Student Award! Established in 1990 by Baosteel and administered under China’s Ministry of Education, the Baosteel Education Award is one of the most prestigious nationwide education honors in China, covering more than 120 universities across 31 provinces and recognizing roughly 500 outstanding students nationwide each year. At the University of Science and Technology Beijing (USTB), the award is selected university-wide across all majors and grade levels, with only two undergraduate recipients granted annually — making it one of USTB’s most competitive student honors. Zuodong is a senior undergraduate majoring in Automation at USTB’s School of Automation and Electrical Engineering, and will join our group for his graduate studies. The award has been officially featured by USTB’s WeChat public account: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/BIi0fDSpUGNLGTRJJCXMlg . We warmly congratulate Zuodong on this remarkable recognition and look forward to welcoming him to the lab.

title: Hongrun Dong Completes His Master’s Thesis and Joins United Imaging Healthcare
text: Congratulations to Hongrun Dong on completing his master’s thesis and starting a new position at United Imaging Healthcare as a Clinical Application Specialist (CAS). His M.Sc. thesis is entitled “Deep Learning for Cone-Beam CT Field-of-View Extension.” The thesis was supervised by Yixing Huang, together with Florian Putz and Andreas Maier. This work focuses on projection-domain completion and outpainting for truncated CBCT projections to improve downstream reconstruction quality. Best wishes to Hongrun for a great start and continued success in his new role.

title: Welcome Dr. Meng Li to Our Team!
text: We are delighted to welcome Dr. Meng Li to join our research group as a postdoctoral researcher on April 1st, 2025. Dr. Li focus on establishing multimodal MRI-based methodologies to assess brain diseases and identify potential biomarkers associated with neuropsychiatric disorders, and her research will further promote our exploration in the field of medical image analysis.

title: Anqi Wang’s Master’s Thesis Research Published in the BVM Proceedings
text: Congratulations to Anqi Wang’s master’s thesis study has been successully published in the German Medical Imaging Conference (BVM) proceeding. Her abstract is entitled Comparative Study of Deep Learning Models for Brain Metastases Autosegmentation . Anqi was a master student of Medical Technology, Friedrich-Alexander University Erlangen-Nuremberg, Germany. Her thesis was jointly supervised by Yixing Huang, Florian Putz and Andreas Maier. Now she is a PhD candidate in the iMRI group , Institute for Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology, Hannover Medical School. Best wishes to Anqi’s PhD life.
